leads.name: Dab Jadwigi Andegawenskiej (Kasserna Park)
leads.why: Fully verified 2026-08-16, held back only to avoid overshooting Poznan's 10-tree target this pass; ready to ship as-is on the next depth pass. Two independent sources: GDOS national register (gid 241335, designated 2024-05-09, CRFOP detail page blocked by an Incapsula bot-check to automated fetches, coordinates/date from the GDOS WFS record) and poznan.pl's 16.04.2024 'Nowe pomniki przyrody' article (the same piece that sourced poz_005/poz_006), which gives trunk circumference 319cm and an estimated age of ~190 years (as of the April 2024 council decision). Stands in Park Tadeusza Kasserna, a roughly 9-hectare public park on Osiedle Chrobrego, Piatkowo district (confirmed public via poznan.pl and local press covering its playground and sports facilities), about 5.4km from the city centre (outside this pass's original 5km supply radius, hence not delivered as a city-centre-cluster tree; it stands alone rather than joining the Plac Wolnosci or Cytadela clusters). Access: free, open public park. Transport: not confirmed this pass. location_precision: confirmed (register tree-level point).
